subject: maths
title: Speed, distance and time
questionPrefix: Solve the speed, distance or time problem

default.aim: Choose the relationship using the quantity requested and matching units.
steps: Identify distance, speed and time, and the quantity requested.
Use hours with km/h: divide minutes by 60. Include stops when total elapsed time is requested.
Use speed = distance ÷ time, distance = speed × time, or time = distance ÷ speed.
For a whole journey use total distance and total time; round only the final result and include units.

teaching.answerNote: In exams, include the correct units in your working and final answer (including £ for money). In this app, enter just the number; the answer field shows the required unit.
